evals.prompt: Summarize the git status and diff of the current branch to draft a PR description.
evals.expected_output: A title and concise PR description grounded in the pinned base/head diff and stated intent. Preserve the repository template when present; otherwise scale sections to the change. State only observed verification and distinguish local changes from the remote PR. No posting or checkout changes.
